name: Chadem
found: Scribe's Corner, when he isn't off in some ruin.
appearance: Thin, ink-stained fingers, one sleeve hanging heavy.
sayings: Is that writing? Let me see.
wants: Pre-Fall texts, and someone to admit he was right.
does_not_want: Anyone from Ilmenor asking after him.
oddly_also: Failed his Ilmenor initiation and has never forgiven them.
offers: Coin for rubbings, inscriptions, and ruin maps; translations.
